Title: Budibase: NoSQL Injection via JSON Parameter Interpolation in MongoDB Query Execution
Description: Budibase's MongoDB query execution endpoint (`POST /api/v2/queries/:queryId`) is vulnerable to NoSQL injection through user-supplied query parameters. The `enrichContext()` function interpolates parameter values into JSON query templates using Handlebars with `noEscaping: true`, then parses the result with `JSON.parse()`. An attacker can inject JSON metacharacters (`"`, `{`, `}`) into parameter values to alter the structure of MongoDB queries, bypassing intended filters to read, modify, or delete arbitrary documents.
Solution: Unfortunately, there is no solution available yet.
